title: COBA: Counterbias Text Augmentation for Mitigating Various Spurious Correlations via Semantic Triples
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating spurious correlations and social biases (gender and racial bias) through a novel data augmentation framework. While bias mitigation is a topic in AI ethics, the paper does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, theology, or formal moral/ethical reasoning frameworks.
